_experiment.scientific_factor: R05 + design-region factored smooth-lDDT objective only
_experiment.root_cause_hypothesis: The remaining R05 Pareto problem includes local/aligned/interface geometry versus absolute placement. R19 isolates whether a physically local, relation-factored geometry objective improves local structure/lDDT/interface on R05 itself. V172 removes the previous implementation-only dependency on MF_REPR_CORE, so no modern representation is silently bundled into this loss experiment.

module_contract.design_mask: The task design mask is the contract (H3 now; can generalize to 6CDR without changing the loss).
module_contract.relations: Normalize design-design, design-fixed-scaffold and design-antigen relations separately, then combine with fixed 1:1:1 relation weights.
module_contract.pair_rules: Exclude same-residue and context-context pairs; use native true-distance cutoff 15 A and smooth thresholds 0.5/1/2/4 A.
module_contract.gradient_authority: Fixed scaffold/antigen coordinates are detached; only designed coordinates receive this auxiliary gradient.
module_contract.representation: Original R05 representation only; MF_REPR_CORE=off. The smooth-lDDT helper is stateless and coordinate-only in V172.
module_contract.weight_rationale: 0.1 is frozen before this experiment and matches the prior R10 ablation weight for comparability; it is not claimed to be MFDesign donor parity.

r05_invariants: PCS-RC source/context and recurrent proposal sequence context
FoldFlow fixed-g residue-level R3 support, g_scaled=0.1, coordinate scaling=0.1
U02 f01_r3_endpoint_canonical_hybrid target and f01_canonical_carrier sampler
three-round state-evolving AbFlow recurrence and dynamic R05 EGNN mechanics
global batch_size=56, max_epoch=200, EMA=0.999, BF16/TF32, Adam/exponential scheduler
Train->Validation->Test every epoch remains unchanged; no validation sample() rollout is introduced

formal_runtime.validation: existing EMA validation only; no sample() rollout

_experiment.decision_rule: Compare only against the same R05 parent. Do not combine this factor with another new module until its own causal effect is established.
